_comment: OUTLET = ELDRAZI DISPLACER, ONE {C} SOURCE -- and the button must NOT appear. This is the
user's own seed-7 diagnosis restated as a fixture: *'there is one colorless on board which
cannot properly feed the sink'*. Displacer's blink is {2}{C}, so a pass produces one colourless
and spends one colourless -- net_c 0 -- and the Infiltrator's {1}{C} can never be paid however
long the loop runs. The starved promotion cannot rescue this board (it delivers the pip; the
outlet eats it), and the projection is right to refuse. Fixture 6 is the same board plus an
Emiel, which IS winnable and must offer the button.
